target.statement: AUC of ODSVM-200 (SUM) on the Ecoli dataset when the minority class is treated as the one class, compared to OCSVM baseline.
target.table_ref: Table 2, row Ecoli, column 'OCSVM-200 SUM' under 'One = minority class'

compute.basis: Ecoli is tiny (336 samples, 7 features); training 200 one-sample OCSVMs and scoring is seconds of CPU work, dominated by pip install and dataset download.

title: Decomposing one-class support vector machine into an ensemble of one-data support vector machines
